segments.note: PROVISIONAL machine alignment reconciled by Codex (gpt-6-astra). Snyoms par zhugs pa owns the complete predicative phrase wrapped in deep meditation at d3, excluding who are; the phrasing is not decomposed into invented wrapped or deep atoms. Lha owns pleasure beings; rnams contributes plural morphology fused into beings, and kyis has no separate agent word. The later nam mkhar owns as empty space: the case-conditioned nam mkha stem owns empty space and its bound r owns predicative as. The nominal 'du shes owns ability to conceptualize, the cognitive faculty which the English says has dissolved; C05:51 also renders nominal 'du shes as ability to discriminate. This local nominal scope excludes their and creates no independent ability equivalent. Gzugs owns physical matter; kyi's relation is expressed through conceptualize taking a direct object, with no separate genitive word. Rnam par owns altogether and the tighter bshig stem owns dissolved, leaving has unwrapped. Only the first phyir owns causal for; ro is a wordless assertive closure. La, ste and the relative/nominal endings are omitted as distributed syntax. Final zhes gsungs pa'i phyir is the unexpressed outer citation frame. Those, who are, at the level we call the, the water, their and has remain unwrapped. C16:828 and C18:1120 contain later apparatus outside this row's shared English; P7:15 ends at has and cannot attest dissolved altogether.
